rows.summary: Typing one character in an entry's bullet, the summary or a personal-info field now renders NO component of any other entry or section: not the card, not a field, not dnd-kit's sortable wrapper or the section header. Per-key work no longer grows with the number of untouched entries or sections. Four changes, each proved by fail-first (run 37402177377, all four jobs green: the test fails without the change, passes with it): SectionEntry/SortableSection memoised (4b1aea05); the Résumé tab's store actions made stable by useStableActions, editor-only (48642a3d); the two SortableContext id arrays kept by useSameList while the ids are equal (10cd2b05); the KeyboardSensor options hoisted to a module constant in both files, because useSensor made a new sensor each render, dnd-kit's activators/internal context changed and woke every sortable (9b1798c7). tests/pdf/165 compares the whole list of rendered components of every untouched entry and section to [] (no name allowlist), plus the edited entry renders in 1-3 commits, plus a useStableActions identity test. CI at final src: tests run 37402187704 green (render test, 71-startup-chunks, 112/114-121 and about 45 editor/store tests), 71-startup-chunks 0.0 kB to spare (same as master).
rows.remaining: PersonalInfoEditor and EditorHeader still take the whole resume and re-render on every key (constant cost, not per entry); memoising them needs them to take narrower props, not trivial. The store still makes new action functions per render (useStableActions hides that for the Résumé tab only; the store is on the start-up path with 0.0 kB to spare).

issues: Reviewer (agent): 5ae6bcba (memoised id lists) was only half effective and unproven by the test; it was reverted (4f62e063) and later replaced by useSameList (10cd2b05) which failfirst proves needed, together with the sensors fix (9b1798c7).

Reviewer: three tests (09-contact-icons, 39-contact-icons-webp, 88-new-section-open) mount EditorResumeTab with a Proxy store whose Object.keys is empty; useStableActions then carries no actions, so Duplicate controls do not render there and a future click through it would throw. They pass on CI.
review.coordinatorReviewOfAgent: The agent's render test (a27f433e) needed my fixes: an allowlist of dnd-kit names (3ca5eb40, now removed), a store-identity test replaced by a useStableActions test, and names of rendered components in the failure message (f4ec5170). Its expanded perf scenario (18cf1e49) holds and runs the 12-job large résumé of tests/perf/fixtures.mjs with every card open.

notes: Start-up cap: master is at 0.0 kB to spare; no byte was added to the start-up path (the stable-actions first attempt in useResumeStore.js tipped 71-startup-chunks and was dropped; useStableActions.js and useSameList.js are editor-only, the editor is route-lazy).
